text: Appeal of Order to Comply (April 25, 2019) for 96 Boulton Drive.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply, dated April 25, 2019, regarding the property located at 96 Boulton Drive, Folder No. 19 144431 PRS 00 IV, and doing so granted an extension of time to August 27, 2019 to resolve the sump pump drainage issues.
